name: Alexandre Défossez
bio: Alexandre Défossez is an AI researcher in Paris working on generative music and speech models for low-latency use. They co-founded Kyutai, where they lead research projects, and spent three years at FAIR Paris leading MusicGen and co-leading AudioCraft. They also co-founded the voice AI company Gradium.
known_for: Moshi real-time spoken dialogue model and Mimi codec
